inference_configuration.confidence_rationale: On the real test split at imgsz 640, F1 is 0.7195 at conf 0.35 versus 0.6222 at 0.55. Confidence 0.55 is a precision-first choice (96.28% precision, 45.96% recall) rather than an F1-maximizing choice. Its false-alarm reduction benefit (0.00/min) is only demonstrated in synthetic Monte Carlo simulation; multi-frame confirmation on continuous live video streams remains unvalidated (unverified).
